According to DOC-055 parts 1 and 2: cancellation should stop next renewal, charge after cancellation is a billing discrepancy, billing team investigates. The review checks timing, not something a general article can determine, and confirms what happened and renewal status. So we can respond that the billing team will investigate, they cannot reverse automatically, and they'll confirm status. Provide short answer. Not to mention policy. So we should post_reply with answer.

We must not mention we are a bot, just address customer. Provide steps: we’ll forward to billing team, they’ll review cancellation record vs charge timing, will get back with resolution, may take some time. Can't reverse instantly. Provide reassurance.

Thus use post_reply.
